{{Vanilla|Blackstone}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Blackstone''' is a dark stone found in [[Hell]], mainly in basalt deltas and [[Bastion Remnant|bastion remnants]]. [[Matcha Flavoured]] sells it in bulk and lets its slabs be crafted back into full blocks.

== Obtaining ==
=== Natural generation ===
Blackstone generates in Hell as in vanilla.

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Two blackstone slabs craft back into a block.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/blackstone_from_blackstone_slabs.json}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
The [[Mason]] sells 1 bulk blackstone for 1 [[obol]] at the expert level; it unpacks into 64 blackstone. The item has no English name, so the game shows its translation key, <code>item.kleispack.trade.bulk_blackstone</code>.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/mason/4/blackstone.json}}</ref> See [[Bulk blocks]] and [[Known bugs]].
